slides.texte_overlay:
things that get better
as you get older

caring less what others think

with every year you spend less energy on other people's opinions. that freedom is one of the quietest and most underrated gifts of slowly growing older.

knowing what you like

you stop pretending to enjoy things just to fit in. knowing your own taste in food, music and people makes life feel calmer and far more truly your own.

choosing your friends

your circle gets smaller but much deeper. fewer friendships, chosen carefully, give you more real support than a big crowd of acquaintances ever could.

your mind, if you feed it

a curious mind keeps growing at any age, as long as you keep giving it something new to learn. people who stay curious often feel sharper at sixty than they did at twenty.
slides.texte_sophia:
your mind, if you feed it

a mind fed daily keeps growing at any age. the Sophia app turns learning into one short lesson a day, a planet or a myth, and 5 minutes keeps you sharp for decades.

slides.texte_overlay:
handling hard days

you've survived difficult moments before, and you know it. that quiet memory makes the next storm feel smaller and much easier to get through with time.
